m: श्रौमत्य m. patr. fr. श्रु-मत्, ŚBr. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 118)

s: klI, (SrutO Bavam । Sruti + aR .) gArhapatyAhavanIyadakziRAgnayaH । yaTA, -- “trayo ye gArhapatyAhavanIyadakziRAgnayaH । idamagnitrikaM SrOtaM tretAgnihotramityapi ॥” iti jawADaraH ॥

tri, (SrutO BavaH । Sruti + aR .) SrutivihitaDarmmAdiH । yaTA, -- “DarmajYErvihito DarmmaH SrOtaH smArtto dviDA dvijEH dAnAgnihotrasambanDamijyA SrOtasya lakzaRam ॥ smArtto varRASramAcAro yamESca niyamEryutaH । pUrveByo vedayitveha SrOtaM saptarzayo'bruvan ॥ fco yajUMzi sAmAni brahmaRo'NgAni sA SrutiH manvantarasyAtItasya smftvA tanmanurabravIt ॥ tataH smArttaH smf to Darmo varRASramaviBAgaSaH । evaM vE dviviDo DarmmaH SizwAcAraH sa ucyate ॥ ijyAvedAtmakaH SrOtaH smArtto varRASramAtmakaH ॥ iti mAtsye 120 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । aDikaraRamAlAkfnmADavAcAryyaDftaparASaraBAzye SAtAtapaH । “SrOtaM karmma svayaM kuryyAdanyo'pi smArttamAcaret aSaktO SrOtamapyanyaH kuryyAdAcAramantataH ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: tri॰ SrutO vihitamaR । 1 vedavihite DarmAdO “SrOtaM krarma svayaM kuryyAt” kAtyA॰ smftiH । 2 gArhapatyAhavanIyadakziRAgnizu pu॰ ।
m: श्रौत mf(ई or आ)n. relating to the ear or hearing, W.
to be heard, audible, expressed in words or in plain language (as a simile, opp. to आर्थ, ‘implied’), Kpr.
relating to sacred tradition, prescribed by or founded on or conformable to the Veda (with जन्मन् n. ‘the second birth of a Brāhman produced by knowledge of the Veda’), Yājñ.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
श्रौत n. relationship resulting from (common study of) the Veda, Hariv.
a fault (incurred in repeating the Veda), Hcat.
any observance ordained by the Veda (e.g. preservation of the sacred fire), W.
the three sacred fires collectively, ib.
a: श्रौत — a. (ती f.) [श्रुतौ विहितं अण्] 1 Relating to the ear. --2 Relating to, founded on, or prescribed by, the Veda. --3 Sacrificial. --तं 1 Any observance prescribed by the Vedas. --2 Ritual enjoined by the Vedas. --3 Preservation or maintenance of the sacred fire. --4 The three sacred fires collectively; (i. e. गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय and दक्षिण). --Comp. --कर्मन् n. a Vedic rite. --सूत्रं N. of a class of Sūtra works based on the Veda (ascribed to आश्वलायन, सांख्यायन, कात्यायन &c.).

श्रौत—प्रायश्चित्त n. N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda and of other works.
श्रौत—प्रश्नोत्तर-व्यवस्था f. rules for sacrificial rites in the form of question and answer.
श्रौत—प्रयोग-सामन् n. pl. N. of wk.

श्रौत—सूत्र n. N. of partic. Sūtras or Sūtra works based on Śruti or the Veda (ascribed to various authors, such as Āpastamba, Āśvalāyana, Kātyāyana, Drāhyāyaṇa &c.; cf. IW. 146)
श्रौत—स्मार्त-धर्म m. a duty enjoined by the V˚ and Sm˚, ib.

m: श्रौषट् ind. (prob. for श्रोषत् Subj. of √ 1. श्रु, ‘may he i.e. the god, hear us!’) an exclamation used in making an offering with fire to the gods or departed spirits (cf. वषट्, वौषट्), RV.; TS.; ŚBr. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 91).
a: श्रौषट् — ind. An exclamation or formula used in making an offering with fire to the gods or departed spirits; cf. वषट् or वौषट्.
